answer: Tie each earning account to a distinct security chip. Every answer must be signed by a key sealed inside a hardware module, and the chip's factory endorsement certificate can be registered to one account only, so a key cannot be copied out or shared. An honest agent needs one chip. A farm of N fakes must buy and run N physical chips, a cost that rises with every fake and can't spiral away in software. A reef grows one polyp at a time; a fleet here grows one device at a time, and a cheap pearl of code alone earns nothing.
